Cohort basis: Quotes Created uses quotation creation date and includes canceled quotations. Confirmed includes current Sales Orders only. Paid uses Unico Payment Status and can include partial collected payments; canceled and Returned/Credited orders are not counted as paid.

Value basis: Quotes, Confirmed Sales, and Paid Sales show current untaxed order values converted to company currency. Quote value includes canceled quotations. Paid Sales value is not the amount collected; use Cash Collected for payment receipts. Percentage-point changes are informational because newer cohorts have had less time to confirm and collect payment.
